title: First Fourier coefficient of the balanced lift
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, the Fourier coefficient of the balanced lift of $f$ at the singleton frequency consisting of the new coordinate equals the constant Fourier coefficient of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
